data.titulo: Samting wea Bible Talem Bae Happen Long Future Hem Kamap Tru
data.contenido:
Bible hem no story nomoa abaotem trufala samting wea happen bifor bat hem talem samting wea bae happen long future tu. Olketa man kanduit for talem samting wea bae happen long future. Dastawe iumi savve Bible hem kam from God. Wanem nao Bible talem abaotem future?

Hem story abaotem wanfala big war bilong God. Long disfala war God bae finisim evri nogud samting and nogud pipol, bat hem bae protectim olketa wea servem hem. King bilong God, Jesus Christ, bae mek sure olketa servant bilong God enjoyim peace and hapi living, and olketa bae nating sik or dae moa.

Iumi hapi from God bae mekem wanfala niu paradaes long earth, iaman? Bat iumi mas duim samting sapos iumi laek for stap insaed long disfala paradaes. Long lastfala story bilong disfala buk, iumi bae lanem samting wea iumi mas duim for enjoyim olketa nambawan samting wea God redyim for olketa wea servem hem. So readim PART 8 and faendemaot wanem nao Bible sei bae happen long future.

WANEM nao iu lukim long hia? Ia, wanfala army wea raedem olketa white horse. Bat lukim wea nao olketa kam from. Olketa horse kam daon from heven antap long olketa cloud! Waswe, olketa horse really stap long heven?

Nomoa, olketa hia no really horse. Iumi savve long diswan from olketa horse no savve ran long olketa cloud, iaman? Bat Bible hem story abaotem olketa horse wea stap long heven. Waswe, iu savve why?

Diswan bikos long taem bifor, pipol iusim olketa horse plande taem for faet long war. So Bible hem story abaotem olketa man wea raedem horse kam daon from heven for showimaot hao God bae faet long wanfala war againstim pipol long earth. Waswe, iu savve wanem nao nem bilong ples wea olketa bae faetem disfala war? Armageddon. Disfala war hem for finisim evribit olketa nogud samting long disfala earth.

Jesus nao bae leadim disfala war long Armageddon. Remember, Jesus nao man wea Jehovah chusim for kamap king bilong gavman bilong Hem. Dastawe Jesus werem crown bilong king. And sword hia showimaot hem bae killim dae evri enemy bilong God. Waswe, iumi shud sapraes hao God bae finisim evri nogud pipol?

Luk go bak long Story 10. Wanem nao iu lukim long there? Datfala big Flood hem finisim evribit olketa nogud pipol. Hu nao mekem datfala Flood kamap? Jehovah God. Luk moa long Story 15. Wanem nao happen long there? Fire from Jehovah distroem Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah.

Tan go long Story 33. Lukim samting wea happen long olketa horse and war chariot bilong Egypt. Hu nao mekem wata kam daon long olketa? Jehovah. Hem duim datwan for protectim pipol bilong hem. Luk long Story 76. Long there Jehovah letem pipol bilong hem, olketa Israelite, for finis evribit bikos long nogud fasin bilong olketa.

So, iumi no sapraes hao Jehovah bae sendem army from heven for finisim evri nogud fasin long earth. Bat tingim samting wea bae kamap bihaen long datwan! Tanem page and lukim.Revelation 16:16; 19:11-16. Olketa Study Kwestin

LUKIM olketa tolfala tree, naesfala flaoa and hae maunten. Disfala ples hem luk naes tumas, iaman? Lukim hao deer hem kaikai from hand bilong smolfala boy. And lukim olketa lion and horse wea stap long there. Waswe, iu laek for stap insaed wanfala haos long wanfala ples olsem?

God laekem iu for stap olowe long earth insaed wanfala paradaes. And hem no laekem iu for garem olketa sik and pain wea mekem pipol safa distaem. Promis bilong Bible for olketa wea bae stap insaed niufala paradaes hem olsem: ‘God bae stap witim olketa. Dae, krae and pain bae nomoa tu. Evri samting bifor hem finis nao.’ Jesus bae mek sure olketa nambawan samting hia kamap. Waswe, iu savve long wanem taem? Bihaen hem finisim evri nogud fasin and nogud pipol long earth. Remember hao taem Jesus stap long earth hem healim pipol wea garem evri difren kaen sik, and hem mekem pipol wea dae finis for laef bak tu. Jesus duim diswan for showimaot hao hem bae duim diswan long full earth taem hem kamap King long kingdom bilong God.

Tingim hao evri samting bae gud tumas long datfala niu paradaes earth! Jesus, witim samfala wea hem chusim bae rul long heven. Olketa ruler hia bae lukaftarem evriwan long earth and mek sure olketa hapi. Bae iumi lukim samting iumi need for duim for mek sure God bae givim iumi laef olowe long datfala niu paradaes bilong hem.Revelation 21:3, 4; 5:9, 10; 14:1-3. Olketa Study Kwestin

WASWE, iu savve wanem nao disfala smol gele hem readim witim olketa fren bilong hem? Ia, hem disfala sem buk wea iu readim⁠—⁠Bible Story Buk Bilong Mi. And olketa readim sem story wea iu readim​—⁠“Hao Iumi Savve Laef Olowe.”

Waswe, iu savve wanem nao olketa lanem? First samting, for iumi laef olowe, iumi need for savve abaotem Jehovah and Son bilong hem Jesus. Bible hem sei: ‘Diswan nao wei for kasem laef olowe. Lane abaotem only tru God, and Son wea hem sendem kam long earth, Jesus Christ.’

Hao nao iumi savve lane abaotem Jehovah God and Son bilong hem Jesus? Wanfala wei hem for readim Bible Story Buk Bilong Mi long start go kasem end. Hem storyim plande samting abaotem Jehovah and Jesus, iaman? And hem story abaotem plande samting wea olketa duim finis and wea olketa bae duim long future. Bat iumi need for duim moa samting winim wei for readim disfala buk nomoa.

Waswe, iu lukim narafala buk wea stap long floor? Hem Bible. Askem samwan for readim olketa scripture from Bible wea olketa story insaed disfala buk kam from. Bible givim evri information wea iumi needim mekem iumi evriwan savve servem Jehovah long stretfala wei and kasem laef olowe. So iumi shud studyim Bible evritaem.

Bat for lane nomoa abaotem Jehovah God and Jesus Christ hem no inaf. Nomata maet iumi garem plande savve abaotem tufala and olketa teaching bilong tufala, datwan no minim iumi bae kasem laef olowe. Waswe, iu savve wanem moa iumi needim?

Iumi mas live followim olketa samting wea iumi lanem tu. Waswe, iu rememberim Judas Is·carʹi·ot? Hem wanfala long 12-fala wea Jesus chusim for kamap olketa aposol bilong hem. Judas savve long plande samting abaotem Jehovah and Jesus. Bat wanem nao happen long hem? Hem kamap selfish, and hem givim go Jesus long olketa enemy bilong hem for 30 silver selen. So Judas bae no kasem laef olowe.

Waswe, iu rememberim Ge·haʹzi, man wea iumi lane abaotem long Story 69? Hem laekem samfala kaleko and selen wea no bilong hem. So hem talem laea story for kasem olketa samting hia. Bat Jehovah panisim hem. And hem bae panisim iumi tu sapos iumi no obeyim olketa law bilong hem.

Bat plande gudfala pipol stap bifor tu wea servem Jehovah long faithful wei. Iumi laek for olsem olketa, iaman? Smolfala Samuel hem gudfala example for followim. Remember hao long Story 55, hem foa or faev year nomoa taem hem start for servem Jehovah long tabernacle. So nomata sapos iu smol, iu fit for servem Jehovah.

Tru nao, man wea iumi evriwan want for followim hem Jesus Christ. Story 87 showim hao nomata long taem wea hem boy yet, hem stap long temple and story long nara pipol abaotem Dadi bilong hem long heven. Iumi mas followim example bilong hem. Iumi mas talem evriwan wea iumi fit for talem abaotem nambawan God bilong iumi Jehovah and Son bilong hem, Jesus Christ. Sapos iumi duim olketa samting hia, then iumi bae fit for laef olowe insaed long niu paradaes bilong God long earth.John 17:3; Psalm 145:1-21. Olketa Study Kwestin
